general.notes: Dual data-rate 1.25 Gbps / 1.063 Gbps; recommended data rate 1250 Mbps. Operating case temperature Standard 0 to +70°C (QT-WDM-0240BD) or Industrial -40 to +85°C (QT-WDM-0240BID). Supply current Icc max 300 mA at 3.13–3.47 V (+3.3 V nominal); power in watts not stated. Transmitter centre wavelength 1480–1580 nm (typ 1550 nm); receiver 1260–1360 nm (typ 1310 nm). BIDI 1550 nm TX / 1310 nm RX. Rx sensitivity and overload per Note 3: PRBS 2^7-1 @ 1250 Mbps, BER ≤ 1×10^-12. Optical power launched into SMF. Spectral width (RMS) Δλ max 1 nm. Optical rise/fall time (20%–80%) max 0.26 ns.
general.suggestions: Vendor is only implied via qsfptek.com contact/domain, not a labeled manufacturer field. Consider temp_min_c/temp_max_c as per-SKU lists when Standard vs Industrial variants differ. Icc 300 mA max could be documented as optional derived power if conversion is allowed.
